mapper.select: select count(*) from user_address where owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} and deleted_at is null

select address_id, owner_user_id, recipient_name, recipient_phone, province, city, district, detail_address, postal_code, default_address, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at from user_address where owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} and deleted_at is null order by default_address desc, updated_at desc, address_id desc

select address_id, owner_user_id, recipient_name, recipient_phone, province, city, district, detail_address, postal_code, default_address, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at from user_address where address_id = #{addressId} and deleted_at is null limit 1
select owner_user_id from user_address where address_id = #{addressId} and deleted_at is null limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into user_address(owner_user_id, recipient_name, recipient_phone, province, city, district, detail_address, postal_code, default_address, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at) values(#{ownerUserId}, #{recipientName}, #{recipientPhone}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{detailAddress}, #{postalCode}, #{defaultAddress}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{deletedAt})
mapper.update: update user_address set recipient_name = #{recipientName}, recipient_phone = #{recipientPhone}, province = #{province}, city = #{city}, district = #{district}, detail_address = #{detailAddress}, postal_code = #{postalCode}, default_address = #{defaultAddress}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where address_id = #{addressId} and owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} and deleted_at is null
update user_address set deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, default_address = 0 where address_id = #{addressId} and owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} and deleted_at is null
